cases.title: Passenger Portal - Sign-On - Anonymous Accounts - Navigation and Styling
cases.section_path: Anonymous Account
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** that a user logs in to the ABT Passenger Portal
**When** the card details are valid for a card that has performed any number of journeys in the previous seven days
**Then** the user will be signed on

Note 1: Passenger portal for SAT will be: https://passengerweb-uktest-tl2-env1.albedo-gen.co.uk
Note 2: Anonymous login will redirect directly to card login hosted by NMI

cases.title: Passenger Portal - Sign-On - Invalid Details Entered
cases.section_path: Anonymous Account
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a user enters invalid details during sign-on
**Then** the user will be prevented from signing on 


Note 1: Passenger portal for SAT will be: https://passengerweb-uktest-tl2-env1.albedo-gen.co.uk
Note 2: Anonymous login will redirect directly to card login hosted by NMI

cases.title: Passenger Portal - Sign-On - No Journeys
cases.section_path: Anonymous Account
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a user attempts to sign in to the Passenger Portal using card details where no Journeys have taken place in the previous seven days
**Then** the Passenger Portal will prevent the user from signing on

Note 1: Passenger portal for SAT will be: https://passengerweb-uktest-tl2-env1.albedo-gen.co.uk
Note 2: Anonymous login will redirect directly to card login hosted by NMI

cases.title: Operator can run a Retail Debt Report
cases.section_path: Operator Web Portal / Reports Management
cases.custom_steps:
https://jira.flowbird.group/browse/CA-11724

Debt Summary - remain the same

Debt Recovery Summary - Remove the following fields as they are not applicable:

Tap attempts
Customer online attempts
Operator online attempts

The Debt Report detail to contain the following columns:

Date/Time
Automatic debt retires
Remaining
Amount
Brand
Masked PAN
Transaction Reference
 

Technical design

The current debt report already collects retail transaction debts as well
The detail of wether the transaction type is retail or op is found in Transaction -> PaymentSchema column. When loading debts, the transaction table is linked as well through the AbtTransactionID column, therefore the information can be obtained for use inside the report as well.
Transaction table seems to be missing an index on (AbtTransactionID, OperatorID) which is used in queries, should be added.
Update Manager / Repository level implementation of debt report to accept 'Payment Schema' filter.
Update existing Debt Report endpoint to specify (controller level, not UI, so internally) Payment Schema to 'op' so debt report displays only op-related debts
Create UI for the new Debt Report (Retail) with the details above)
Create new endpoint in the OWG for the debt report (retail) similar to op one, but specifying Payment Schema = 'retail'
Add a new role for the new report
Link to debt report details (to update in case of changes): Reporting - ABT - How they work (technical & business wise) - Cloudfare ABT - Flowbird Confluence

cases.title: Administrator can configure the End of the Operational Day
cases.section_path: Operator Web Portal / Administrator Settings Management
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** An ABT Operator has signed into the Operator Portal
**When** the ABT Operator sets the End of the Operational Day
**Then** each operational day will be a 24 hour period
**And** each operational day will end at the time configured for End of the Operational Day
**And** each subsequent operational day will begin the minute after the time configured for End of the Operational Day

cases.title: Administrator can configure the End of the Operational Week
cases.section_path: Operator Web Portal / Administrator Settings Management
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** An ABT Operator has signed into the Operator Portal
**And** the ABT Operator has set the End of the Operational Day
**When** the ABT Operator sets the End of the Operational Week
**Then** each operational week will be a 7 day period (start and end times based on configured End of the Operational Day)
**And** each operational week will end on the day configured for End of the Operational Week
**And** each subsequent operational week will begin the day after the day configured for End of the Operational Week

cases.title: Administrator can configure the maximum late data period

cases.custom_steps:

As an Administrator I want to set a maximum late data period, so that late tap data can be processed when inside the period, differently to outside the period.

cases.title: ABT processes Taps received <= 14 days from date the date a customer tapped on the device
cases.section_path: Late Taps
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customer made a transaction tap on a device 
**And** Payment handling has already occurred (payment clears)
**And** the ABT Operator has configured the Maximum Late Data Period to 14 days
**When** the ABT system receives this tap <= 14 days from the customer's tap 
**Then** the ABT System will successfully process the tap
**And** the system will make any necessary adjustments to charges
**And** the customer will be charged the correct amount for their travel

cases.title: ABT rejects Taps received >14 days from date the date a customer tapped on the device
cases.section_path: Late Taps
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customer made a transaction tap on a device 
**And** the ABT Operator has configured the Maximum Late Data Period to 14 days
**When** the ABT system receives this tap > 14 days from the customer's tap 
**Then** the ABT System will reject the tap and not charge the card used for the journey


As Transport Operator I want to process taps received up to 14 days (configurable by a Flowbird Administrator) from the date the customer taps on a device, so that fares can be calculated. 



Note: Taps taken from both a Payment Card or Smartcard 



Constraint: 



	Late Date can be configured to a Maximum of 14 Days

	Taps not immediately received but within the 14 days are processed and any caps that should have been applied are done so retrospectively.

	Any taps received after the configured â€œlate periodâ€ can be identified in the â€œDebt Written Offâ€ report.  Late taps clearly flagged in the customer portal for the customer to see, in order to reduce customer service calls to the tenant.  The business rule algorithm applies the late tap and automatically recalculates the aggregated fare and makes a correction to the customer account balance on the following day of travel.

	Duplicate Taps are discarded by the system

cases.title: Card Added to the Deny List when card fails authorisation for payment
cases.section_path: Debt Recovery
cases.custom_steps:
**Given** a customers card is not on the deny list 
**When** the card fails authorisation for a payment
**Then** the customer's card will be automatically added to the Deny List

As a Transport Operator I want customers who's payment cards fail to be authorised for payment to be added to a deny list, so that customers cannot travel until they have resolved the issue. 



Constraint:



	Any card that has had an authorisation or account verification declined will be added to the deny list

	Once a debt recovery has been initiated and is successful then the deny list is updated and any updates (additions and deletions) are sent to all card readers including Revenue Inspection devices, every 15 minutes (frequency exceeds card scheme rules which require updates to be within 1 hour)

cases.title: Card on Deny List is prevented from use on future travel until the issue has been resolved

cases.custom_steps:

**And** devices have been updated with the latest Deny List
**And** the card remains unable to pass authorisation for payment 
**When** the customer attempts to use this blocked card for further transactions
**Then** the card will be declined preventing travel using a blocked card

**Given** a customers card is on the deny list
